inviteProgress.remaining_one: {{count}} step left to accept the tutor’s invitation
inviteProgress.remaining_other: {{count}} steps left to accept the tutor’s invitation
inviteProgress.hint: All steps take just a few minutes

onboarding.tutorDescription: In 2 minutes we'll show how to create a classroom, invite a student, and schedule the first lesson
onboarding.studentDescription: Want a quick overview of how things work?
onboarding.mobileDescription: Want a quick overview of how things work?

sidebar-sections.title: Sections
sidebar-sections.body: From here you can open the schedule, classrooms, materials, and other sections

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Here you'll find notifications about lessons and other events

sidebar-toggle.title: Sidebar
sidebar-toggle.body: Collapse the sidebar to free up space. You can open it again with the same button

user-profile.title: Profile menu
user-profile.body: Click your name or avatar to open the profile menu

user-menu.title: Profile menu
user-menu.body: Here you can check your plan, open settings, or contact support

settings-item.title: Settings
settings-item.body: Here you can change your profile details, set up the camera and microphone, and choose the language and appearance

support-menu.title: Help
support-menu.body: Here you can contact support, find answers, or go through the introduction again

classrooms.title: Classrooms
classrooms.body: Your classrooms for individual and group lessons are here

demo-classroom-card.title: Demo classroom
demo-classroom-card.body: A classroom has everything you need for a lesson: boards, materials, and the schedule. Open the demo classroom to see what it can do

classroom-nav.title: Classroom sections
classroom-nav.body: Here you can switch between boards, notes, files, and the other sections of the classroom

start-call.title: Start the lesson
start-call.body: Click “Start lesson” to begin the video call. Students in the classroom will be notified that the lesson has started.

students.title: Students
students.body: Your students are here. You can also invite new ones

students-invite.title: Student invitation
students-invite.body: Click to get a link for inviting a student

invite-link.title: Invitation link
invite-link.body: Copy the ready message or just the link and send it to a student. One link can be sent to several students

invite-action.title: Invitation
invite-action.body: The invitation form opens next. The step counts once an invitation exists.

materials.title: Personal materials
materials.body: Your boards and notes are stored here. You can use them to prepare for lessons and add them to students' classrooms

create-board.title: Create a board
create-board.body: Here you can create a board to prepare materials for lessons. It is saved in your personal section

board-back.title: Board is ready
board-back.body: You can now use the board as a template for lessons. We'll go back to materials and add a copy to a classroom

template-card.title: Your board
template-card.body: The board is stored in your materials. You can create copies for different students and keep the original

template-menu.title: Copy to a classroom
template-menu.body: Open the board menu and choose “Duplicate to classroom” to create a copy for lessons

duplicate-modal.title: Choose a classroom
duplicate-modal.body: Choose the classroom where you want to use the board. You can also set the student's editing rights

template-copy.title: Independent copies
template-copy.body: A copy of the board is now in the classroom. You can change it together with the student — the original in your personal materials stays unchanged

material-action.title: New material
material-action.body: Choose a board or a note. Closing the list without a choice does not count.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.body: All lessons open from here. Next we'll schedule the first one.

lesson-action.title: New lesson
lesson-action.body: Pick a student and a time. The step counts once the lesson appears on the schedule.

classrooms.title: How to join
classrooms.body: The classroom appears when you open your tutor's link in this account. If you do not have a link yet, ask your tutor to send one

classrooms.title: Classrooms
classrooms.body: Classrooms where you study are listed here. We'll open yours and look at how it is organized

classroom-header.title: Classroom
classroom-header.body: This is where lessons with your tutor happen: materials, the schedule, and the video call

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.body: This is where you see when your lessons are. We'll open it to look at the upcoming ones

schedule-page.title: Your lessons
schedule-page.body: When your tutor schedules a lesson, the date and time show up in this list. If it is empty, nothing is scheduled yet

errorPage.notFoundText: The address is incorrect or the page has been deleted

tutor.lockedHint: This classroom is unavailable because the active classroom limit is reached. To set it to Studying, pause another classroom or complete learning there.

student.lockedHint: Your tutor is not running lessons in this classroom right now.
